description:
Audit and adjust all interactive elements to meet the 44x44 point minimum touch target size. Add visual indicators for undersized touch areas and auto-fix tool to resize buttons, icons, and form controls.

**Rationale:** Small touch targets frustrate users and cause accidental taps. Proper sizing improves accessibility and reduces user errors on mobile devices.
title: Minimum Touch Target Sizing
